pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English (All Levels)
pro_course_detail.description:
My Conversational English lessons are designed to help students of all proficiency levels—from beginners to experts—develop their speaking skills in a supportive and engaging environment.

Core Activities: 
Role-Playing: Simulate real-life scenarios (e.g., ordering food, job interviews, travel).
Discussion Circles: Group discussions on selected topics (e.g., hobbies, cultural differences).
Debate Sessions: Structured debates on controversial issues (e.g., environmental policies).
Storytelling: Students create and share stories based on prompts, enhancing creativity and fluency.
Conversation Games: Interactive games (e.g., “20 Questions,” “Would You Rather?”) to build vocabulary and spontaneity.

Material and Resources:
Articles and Short Stories: Authentic reading materials to stimulate discussion.
Videos and Podcasts: Multimedia resources to expose students to various accents and conversational styles.
Real-life Objects and Pictures: Visual aids to spark conversations and build descriptive language skills.

Each lesson is tailored to the students’ levels and needs, ensuring a balance between structured activities and free-flowing conversation. The goal is to build confidence, improve fluency, and make learning English an enjoyable and rewarding experience. Through varied activities, authentic materials, and diverse topics, students will find themselves more comfortable and proficient in conversational English.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Studying Abroad
pro_course_detail.description:
The "English for Studying Abroad" course is designed to equip students with the language skills and cultural knowledge needed to succeed in an academic setting abroad. The course will cover a range of levels, from beginner to advanced, ensuring that all students receive tailored instruction to meet their specific needs.

Beginner Level:
-Vocabulary building: Common academic terms, classroom objects, basic phrases.
Simple conversations: Introducing oneself, asking for directions, basic classroom interactions.
-Reading and comprehension: Short texts related to student life, simple articles.
-Listening exercises: Understanding classroom instructions, short dialogues.

Intermediate Level:
-Expanded vocabulary: Subject-specific terminology, idiomatic expressions.
-Group discussions: Participating in study groups, sharing opinions on academic topics.
-Reading and writing: Summarizing articles, writing short essays.
-Listening and speaking: Note-taking from lectures, presenting ideas in class.

Advanced Level:
-Advanced vocabulary: Academic research terms, professional jargon.
-Debates and presentations: Arguing a point of view, delivering structured presentations.
-In-depth reading: Analyzing journal articles, critical thinking exercises.
-Writing: Crafting research papers, composing formal emails.

By the end of this course, students will feel confident and prepared to navigate the academic challenges and cultural differences they will encounter while studying abroad.

Please just do a single class to start. The first class addresses _how_ to answer a question AKA the Problem Solving flowchart. (listen, example, brute force, optimize using BUD, walk through, implement, test)

Lesson Schedule:

0: The Problem-Solving Flowchart
1. Arrays and Strings
2. Linked Lists
3. Stacks and Queues
4. Trees and Graphs
5. Bit Manipulation
6. Math and Logic Puzzles
7. Object-Oriented Design
8. Recursion and DP
9. System Design and Scalability
10. Sorting and Search

Typical Class:
- Before the class: you read the next chapter
- In class, I give you an _easy_ question from the lesson
- You answer (following the flow chart) using pseudocode
- I give you hints and English tips as we go
- After class, you read and prepare the next lesson

Please message me when booking this class and tell me your stack!!!

Important!!! If you're looking to do this class but the price is too high, message me. I'm also looking for students to do it for my YT channel. For those students, the price is lower. Message me if this interests you.

If you just want to discuss general tech topics, please just schedule a regular conversation lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: Supremo Latin American Spanish
pro_course_detail.description:
This is a unique opportunity for you since I am American and English is my first language. My Spanish is near-native. That means that I'm not just fluent in Spanish, but quite often I am mistaken for a native speaker and because of how well I speak and interact in Spanish many natives are surprised that I'm American. 

Since there are so many native Spanish speakers on italki, why take classes with me?  Sooner or later there will be some expressions, concepts or ideas that you will not be able to either understand or express. A native Spanish speaker won't necessarily be able to explain this and help you to clear up your confusion on the subject the way I can. Sometimes a hundred examples just doesn't help you to know how to say something. As a speaker of English I usually anticipate what my students are trying to say. My classes are extremely productive. 

I have been a translator and interpreter for over 20 years. I've lived in Spain, Colombia, Peru, Chile, Costa Rica and Panama.  So not only do I speak Spanish almost like a native, but I'm familiar with some of the accents and vocabulary differences that you might come across from country to country. 

It's a great language. It's fun to learn, but it does take work.  Why not try some classes with me. I know you'll enjoy them.

pro_course_detail.title: Professional Conversation Practice – Improve Fluency!
pro_course_detail.description:
Want to improve your conversational English in a low stress environment? 
Want to improve your fluency and speak English with more confidence?

Do you feel like you understand grammar better than you can speak? These lessons are designed for you! 

During our time together we will have a relaxed conversation about topics important to you. These lessons focus on pronunciation, fluency, learning to speak with confidence, being able to articulate what you want to say, and help improve your listening skills as we speak American English together. 

We can focus on either social conversation, or more professional style conversation, depending on your needs. These lessons do not have homework and the goal of these lessons is to remain relaxed.

I will typically not make many corrections during our time together in order to not break the conversational fluency practice. (I will make corrections during the lesson upon request of the student, and also if there is a repeating error which is hindering our time).

These lessons are for all levels of English and a trial lesson is not needed.

* The primary difference between professional and social English is whether colloquial speech is used. Colloquial speech is basically “common slang” which is very common in movies, music, and among friends, but not usually appropriate in a professional setting.

pro_course_detail.title: Proofreading – University Papers and Professional Documents
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you have a university or professional paper in need of proofreading?

While I am not able to write or re-write papers for you, I will correct spelling, grammar, and offer suggestions when a sentence is not worded naturally. I will always grade for spelling and grammar, while word choice will be graded based on the individual's English level. (English levels A1-native)

You will need to send me the paper in advance of the lesson as an attachment so that I am able to proofread your document. Please note that all papers require that I am given the paper at least 5 work days in advance of the lesson. However, the true length of time needed will only be given after you are able to provide me with the paper. This is because the amount of time I need for proofreading depends on the topic as well as your personal English level and ability.

You must also send the paper in a workable format so that I can make edits. (As in, not a PDF). A short explanation of the goal of the paper is also needed. 

As soon as I receive the document, I will immediately open it and respond to you confirming that I can open the document. If I cannot open the document, I will respond immediately requesting a different format. I will then return the corrected paper back to you by the time of the scheduled lesson.

Please note that an hour lesson is up to 1000 words. (This is a little over a 4 page paper double spaced in 12 point Times New Roman font). 

If the paper is longer, you are able to book additional hours to cover the correct word count. (For example, up to 1000 words requires an hour lesson, up to 2000 words requires two hours to be booked,  up to 3000 words requires 3 hours to be booked, etc.)

Please keep in mind that an hour lesson is for the time spent making corrections. If you would like to additionally discuss the corrections over Skype, please consult my “Discussion of University and Professional Papers” class. I appreciate your understanding.

pro_course_detail.title: Perfect Pronunciation Drilling!
pro_course_detail.description:
This class is designed for advanced speakers of English. If you are able to speak fluently, but your accent is simply not improving, this class is designed for you.

This is an intensive class which helps you improve your accent and your ability to pronounce words naturally and correctly. 

Areas we will address include:
- articulation (the actual pronunciation of words)
- intonation (the rise and fall of your voice)
- stress (the emphasis of words)

During this class you will need to read a text. I will provide the text for us to review, but if you have your own text which you would like to read, please keep in mind that your text will need to be at least two pages long and I will need a copy of your text at least 24 hours in advance.

Please also keep in mind that this class is not designed to improve your conversation skills or fluency. This class strictly focuses on your pronunciation in order to reduce your accent. 

If you are interested in improving your speaking ability so that you are able to speak with more confidence and fluency, you are looking for my “Conversation Practice – Improve Fluency” class. 

My “Conversation Practice – Improve Fluency” class also addresses your accent and pronunciation, but unlike this class, it is additionally designed to improve your speaking ability overall, with a focus on improving your confidence and fluency.
